title: Remediation round (v2): R1 one-step retest of angle B on G2F; R2 boundary screen (A1 only) of angle A on BRIWECS winter wheat; R3 data-acquisition manifest
status: FROZEN before any R1/R2 analysis. Round-1 verdicts (A NO_GO, B NO_GO on G2F; AB_gonogo_verdict.json sha256 e55c2496...) stand and are not revisited by this round.
why_this_round: Round-1 diagnostics (post hoc): B4's two-step design attenuates correlations (BLUP slope reliability ~0.43) and used one temperature axis; A was untestable on G2F because within-env maturity spread is narrow (median hybrid-mean silking SD 2.64 d). R1 tests B with a higher-power one-step design; R2 tests whether any public panel offers enough within-env phenology spread for A to be testable at all.

R1_B_one_step.score: round-1 B3 projected growing-season temperature score (ridge alpha 3162 fitted on 4,053 SeeD landraces, 319 overlap SNPs, v5 coordinates) - regenerated from round-1 code without any re-tuning; standardized over analysed hybrids
R1_B_one_step.data: G2F 2014-2018 hybrid x env means (env-centred yield as in v1), genotyped hybrids with >=3 envs having the axis defined
R1_B_one_step.env_anchor: env mean over hybrids of observed hybrid-mean silking GDD (2014-2018 training data; same as round-1 B4)

axes.T1: env mean T2M_MAX in W1 [-400,-50] GDD around anchor
axes.T2: env mean T2M_MAX in W2 [-50,150] (round-1 B4 axis)
axes.T4: env mean T2M from env median planting date to anchor+750 GDD

R1_B_one_step.model: per axis k: y_ij = fixed[ T_k + s_i + s_i*T_k + tester dummies + tester*T_k + PC1..10 + PC1..10*T_k ] + random[ hybrid intercept + hybrid slope on T_k ] + e; T_k and s z-scored; REML (statsmodels MixedLM); PCs = round-1 G2F PCs
R1_B_one_step.test: Wald z of gamma_k = coefficient of s_i*T_k; pre-declared direction gamma_k > 0 (warmer-adapted score -> less negative response to warmer trial temperature)
R1_B_one_step.permutation: for every axis that passes the parametric test: 200 coefficient-permuted score projections (round-1 primary null), refit, empirical two-sided p < 0.05 required
R1_B_one_step.PASS: >=1 axis with gamma_k > 0, parametric p < 0.0125 and permutation p < 0.05
R1_B_one_step.WRONG_SIGN: significant but gamma_k < 0 -> counted as FAIL (structure-like, not adaptation)
R1_B_one_step.FAIL: otherwise; B on G2F closed under the higher-power design
R1_B_one_step.report_also: SE of gamma per axis and the minimal detectable |gamma| at 80% power (alpha 0.0125) in Mg/ha per SD of score per SD of T
R1_B_one_step.if_PASS: run round-1 prereg B5 exactly (M0plus from run_A.py + score_z x EC_env; forward years 2019-2021; GO/WEAK_GO/NO_GO as in v1)

data_preference: BRIWECS extended MET dataset, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.27910269 (if it has plot/genotype-level heading, sowing date, daily weather)
else Sabir et al. 2023 Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8248543 (220 cultivars x 48 envs, daily climate_data.csv)
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.env_definition: location x year x management treatment as coded in the source (treatments shift phenology)
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.thermal_time: base 0 C daily mean temperature ((Tmax+Tmin)/2 if Tmean absent) accumulated from env median sowing date
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.anchor: cultivar x env heading date converted to thermal time
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.within_env_share: same definition as v1 A1 (equal-weight mean over envs of within-env variance / total variance of cultivar x env EC)
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.PASS: median within-env heading SD >= 5 days AND >=2 of 15 ECs with within-env share >= 0.10
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.FAIL: median within-env heading SD < 3 days OR all 15 ECs < 0.05
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.genotype_feasibility: locate public SNP genotypes for the BRIWECS cultivars (e.g., Voss-Fels et al. 2019 / Lichthardt et al. 2019 / Sci Data 2025 release); report n cultivars matched; no A2/A3 in this round
R2_A_boundary_screen_BRIWECS.consequence: PASS + genotypes available -> A2/A3 on BRIWECS in a later round with its own prereg; FAIL -> angle A closed on the public panels examined

R3_data_manifest.deliverable: manifest CSV (dataset, DOI/URL, files, size, license, access method, sandbox status) + official-API/official-tool download scripts with sha256 verification + counts of G2F hybrids whose both parents appear in each public dense inbred panel
R3_data_manifest.access_policy: official APIs/tools only, default User-Agent, rate-limited; no WAF/bot-challenge circumvention, no mirrors/proxies; blocked sources are recorded with manual or official-tool instructions for the user

reporting_rules: all gate outcomes reported including failures
results frozen as JSON with sha256
